title: Controlled gates and the Bell preparation
objectives: Apply CNOT by its basis permutation.
Distinguish coherent control from measuring a control bit.
prerequisites: Chapters 3–5: tensor products, complex amplitudes, unitary gates, Born probabilities and measurement bases.

quizzes.question: What does CNOT with A control do to |10⟩?
feedback: Correct: retain A and flip B.

quizzes.question: Does CNOT always create entanglement?
options: No: it depends on the input.
No: it can never create entanglement.
feedback: Correct: plus⊗zero becomes entangled, while plus⊗plus does not.
The Bell preparation is a counterexample.
